title: 第572章 传播下第571章 传播上
slug: 女装后我在修行界当白月光
content_zh:
消息传到一片漂浮在星海中的陨石群落，那里栖息着铁岩族。
这些铁岩族的族人浑身覆盖着灰黑色的坚硬岩石，性格粗犷豪放，向来只服强者。
当消息传来时，正在锻造兵器的铁岩族们纷纷停下了手中的锤子，面面相觑。
你说人族把圣光神城都打下来了？
城都搬空了？
那神族难道就没有反抗吗？竟然这么快就全没了？
报信的斥候点头如捣蒜：
全没了！圣光被熄灭灭了，城墙也倒了，箭塔都折了。
神族连矿脉都没来得及封存，被人族全部挖走了！
为首的铁岩族首领沉默片刻，忽然仰天大笑：
哈哈哈哈！痛快！痛快！
老子活了八千年，看神族那副高高在上的嘴脸看了八千年！
他们不是自诩天命所归吗？
不是瞧不起万族吗？如今怎么样？
被人族打得连城都不要了！痛快！
旁边一位族人挠了挠岩石头颅，瓮声瓮气地问道：
首领，那咱们以后该怎么办？
首领一挥手，目光炯炯说道：
以后？以后人族就是域外战场最大的。
咱们得认这个老大。

谁拳头大谁说话，天经地义！
消息越传越远，越传越广，所到之处无不是一片哗然。
太阴圣女，不，是太阴女帝林渊！
这个名字从今以后要记牢了！
要对这位大人保持最高的尊敬！
一人之力，覆灭万族联军……
这还是人能做到的事吗？
那么多准帝啊！据说被太阴女帝林渊阁下一剑斩杀了！
九大异族的皇城啊，说破就破，说搬空就搬空。
那可是人家经营万古的老巢啊。
人族这是要崛起了。
不对，人族已经崛起了。
从今往后，域外战场的天要变了。
九大异族再也不敢出来了，人族太阴女帝林渊阁下才是这片星空的主宰。
跟着太阴女帝走，人族必定是域外战场的新霸主。
咱们这些中小族群，得赶紧想想往后该怎么站队了。
站队？还用想吗？谁强跟谁走。如今人族就是最强的。
各种族群的议论声如同潮水般涌动着。
有惊叹的中小族群，也有敬畏不已的，还有惶恐或者狂喜的族群。
以及那些曾经轻视过人族的种族，此刻懊悔得捶胸顿足。

以前总觉得人族在十大顶级族群里孱弱可欺。
九大异族联手攻伐人族的时候，我还觉得人族这回怕是要惨了。
content_en:
News spread to a meteorite community floating in the sea of ​​​​stars, where the Iron Rock Tribe lived.
These people of the Iron Rock Tribe are covered with gray-black hard rocks. They have rough and bold personalities and have always obeyed only the strong.
When the news came, the Iron Rock tribesmen who were forging weapons stopped their hammers and looked at each other.
You said that the human race defeated the Holy Light City?
The city has been evacuated?
Then didn’t the Gods resist? It was all gone so quickly?
The scout who reported the news nodded like a fool:
All gone! The holy light was extinguished, the city walls fell down, and the arrow towers were broken.
The Protoss didn't even have time to seal the mineral veins, and they were all mined by the Human Race!
The leader of the Tieyan Tribe was silent for a moment, then suddenly looked up to the sky and laughed:
Hahahaha! happy! happy!
I have lived for eight thousand years, and I have watched the aloof faces of the gods for eight thousand years!
Don’t they think they are destined to do so?
Don’t you look down on all races? How is it now?
He was beaten so hard by the human race that he even lost his city! happy!
A tribesman next to him scratched his rock head and asked angrily:
Chief, what should we do next?
The leader waved his hand and said with bright eyes:
Later? From now on, the human race will be the largest battlefield outside the territory.
We have to recognize this boss.
Whoever has the bigger fist speaks, it's natural!
The news spread farther and farther, spreading wider and wider, causing uproar everywhere it went.
Taiyin Saint, no, it’s Taiyin Empress Lin Yuan!
I will remember this name from now on!
Maintain the highest respect for this gentleman!
The power of one person can destroy the coalition of all races...
Is this still something humans can do?
So many quasi-emperors! It is said that he was killed by Taiyin Empress Lin Yuan with one sword!
The imperial cities of the nine foreign races will be destroyed at any time and evacuated at any time.
That's the old nest where people have been operating for eternity.
The human race is about to rise.
No, the human race has risen.
From now on, the situation on the battlefield outside the territory will change.
The nine alien races no longer dare to come out. Her Excellency Lin Yuan, the human Taiyin Empress, is the master of this starry sky.
Following the Taiyin Empress, the human race will surely become the new overlord of the battlefield outside the territory.
We, the small and medium-sized ethnic groups, must quickly think about how to stand in line in the future.
Take sides? No need to think about it? Whoever is forced to follow. Now the human race is the strongest.
Discussions from various ethnic groups surged like a tidal wave.
There are small and medium-sized groups that are amazed, there are also groups that are in awe, and there are groups that are frightened or ecstatic.
And those races that once despised the human race are now beating their chests with regret.
In the past, I always felt that the human race was weak and vulnerable among the top ten ethnic groups.
When the nine major alien races joined forces to attack the human race, I thought that the human race would be in trouble this time.
